description: This file defines API routes for managing, executing, and retrieving test run data in a test management system. It includes endpoints for creating test runs, executing test cases, listing runs, and fetching run artifacts, integrating with a database, storage, and robot execution services.

methods.name: execute_test_run(run_id: int, robot_file_path: str, testcase_name: Optional[str], variables: Optional[dict], include_tags: Optional[str], exclude_tags: Optional[str], timeout: Optional[int])
methods.description: Background task that executes a robot test or test case, updates run status, saves artifacts, and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: RunResponse create_run( run_create: RunCreate, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to create and start execution of a test run on a full robot test file in the background.

methods.name: RunResponse run_testcase( request: RunTestCaseRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to execute a specific test case within a robot test file in the background.

methods.name: List[RunResponse] list_runs( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, status_filter: Optional[RunStatus] = None, group_id: Optional[str] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a list of all test runs with optional filtering.

methods.name: RunResponse get_run( run_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve detailed information about a specific test run.

methods.name: RunLogsResponse get_run_logs( run_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve presigned URLs and log content for completed runs.

methods.name: List[RunResponse] queue_batch_execution( request: RunQueueExecuteRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to queue multiple test files or test cases for execution in batch.
